A plug-in is valid only in the Map that is loaded.

#cfa7a0fWhat is custom model?#n
Custom model is an appearance which blocks, items and creatures can use. Players can make bones, which are made from miniature model, with custom model editor. Then edit the animation on timer shaft. After you finish a model, you can generate it into a block, items or creature. 
 
#cfa7a0fHow to enter the editing interface?#n
1. Place the custom model editor on the ground.
2. Select #c0aaa1asample model#n, or choose #c0aaa1acustom model#n to start from scratch.
3. Click the #c0aaa1aimport button#n on select mode type interface. Import the custom model, which is made before. Modify and save.
 
#cfa7a0fHow to edit a model?#n
1. Click the create button to create a new unit. Select the unit and create the sub-unit.
2. Drag the 3D coordinate axis or change the bone and model parameter. (Notice: The blue point is the center point. The rotation of the model is relative to the position of the center point)
 
#cfa7a0fHow to edit animation?#n
1. After you finish a model, click animation.
2. Click the first button below to edit the duration. 
3. Select the unit that you want to adjust. Click on the timer shaft to place the pointer at the point in time you want to change, click + to add a keyframe, or directly adjust the widget, and the keyframe will be automatically inserted.
4. After the keyframe is selected, you can adjust the position of it above the timer shaft or copy, paste, delete.
 
#cfa7a0fHow to generate a model?#n
1. Click the #c0aaa1abutton#n on the top left corner to generate block, items or creature.
2. The generated custom model will be added in resource library.
3. Blocks in plugin library, items and creature appearance can all use the custom model in resource library. 
 
#cfa7a0fHow to use sample model?#n
1. Select a sample model you like.
2. Select a loaded model on the right side.
3. Click the manage button. Select #c0aaa1aModify#n and choose a miniature model. Adjust the #c0aaa1amodel parameter#n.
4.Enter the animation editing interface. We've set some animations. You can adjust them as you like.

#cfa7a0fWhat's the difference between bone parameter and model parameter?#n
1. Use #c0aaa1abone parameter#n or #c0aaa1amodel parameter#n to adjust the units.
2. Bone parameter: Adjust the whole unit and the displacement, rotation, scaling of sub-unit. Sub-units are influenced as the main units change.
3. Model parameter: Will not affect the center point of the bone or parameter of sub-units.
4. You can only adjust bone parameter in animation editing.
 
#cfa7a0fWhat're the unit and sub-unit?#n
1. After selecting a unit, click to create a sub-unit of it. The newly created unit becomes the sub-unit of the selected unit. 
2. When you adjust the bone parameter of the main unit, the sub-unit will also change with it.

#cfa7a0fWhat is Resource Center?#n
Resource Center is where players manage their resources(such as miniature models).
 
 #cfa7a0fResource Center-What is current map used for?#n
 1.The resources that players create in map will be saved in Resource Center-Current map. You can only use these resources in this map.
 2.You can sort, move, delete these resources in Resource Center-Current map.
 3. You can copy the resources to Main Library by moving the resources in current map. You can visit the main library in other maps.
 
 #cfa7a0fWhat is Resource Center-Main Library used for?#n
 1. You can only visit resources of current map in this map. But you can visit resources of Main Library in all maps. The Main Library is like the transfer station of all maps.
 2. You can move/copy the resources of current map to the Main Library. Also save the resources in Main Library which are downloaded in Resource Gallery. 
 3. You can sort, move, upload, cancel uploading, download, delete resources in Resource Center-Main Library.
 
 #cfa7a0fHow to use the resources?#n
 1. Click resource to use it in shortcut bar.
 2. Click resources in Main Library, then the resources will be copied in current map automatically.
 3. Select a folder and manage it in corresponding resources list. Batch select resources and move it to current map.
 4. Rresources in Resource Center can be used to make plugin's appearance.
 5. Creature model block, custom model eidtor can use the resources in Resource Center.
 
 #cfa7a0fHow to upload resources?#n
 1. Click manage to select resources which are not uploaded. Click upload. Successfully uploaded resources will have a cloud icon on the top left corner.
 2. Notice: The number of uploaded resources and size will be limited.
 
 #cfa7a0fWhat is uploaded resource used for?#n
 1. If you change devices, you can still download resources which are uploaded before.
 2. Already uploaded resources can be shared. Others can download and use.

 #cfa7a0fHow to cancel uploading?#n
 1. Click manage to select uploaded resources and cancel uploading.
 2. Notice: You can't cancel uploading if resources are already on the shelf(Already used in items. You need to remove it from the shelf to cancel uploading.
 
 #cfa7a0f What is resource of secondary creation?#n
 1. If you use resources downloaded in Resource Gallery in creature model blocks or custom model editor, the generated resources will be resources of secondary resources.
 2. You cannot upload resources of secondary creation. Can only use it locally.

#cfa7a0fWhat is Resource Gallery?#n
 Resource Gallery is where players share and download resources(such as miniature models).
 
 #cfa7a0fHow to upload resources?#n
 1.Click Mine - Product to add items.
 2. Add uploaded resources in Resource Center-Main library. Fill in the information and select the tag.
 3. Click Put on Shelf, item will enter review mode. When it gets passed, it will be displayed in Resource Gallery.
 4. Excellent resources may be featured. 
 
 #cfa7a0fHow to download resources?#n
 1. You can check item details in Resource Gallery. Click to download. Notice: The number of free items downloading is limited.
 2. Downloaded resources will be saved in Resource Center-Main Library. 
 3. Downloaded items can be found in Resource Gallery-Purchased. Notice: Free items will not be saved in server. If you change the devices, the list of downloaded items will be lost. Already downloaded resources will not be affected.
 
 #cfa7a0fWhat can downloaded resources used for?#n
 1. Downloaded resources can be used in maps and create objects, such as blocks, items and creatures.
 2. Can use the appearance of plugins.
 3. Used in creature models, custom model editors. Notice: If you use downloaded resources to create, the finished resources will be secondary creation and cannot be uploaded to Main Library.
 
 #cfa7a0fHow to delete the items already on the shelf?#n
 1. Click items on the shelf in Mine-Product, remove it from shelf in item detail page. Notice: The items which are removed from the shelf is only visible to you. All the datas are saved. Can be put on shelf again.
 2. Click the items which is already removed from shelf. Delete it in item detail page. Notice: The data will also be deleted and other players cannot download.
 
 #cfa7a0fWhat is item ID?#n
 1. Click More in bottom right corner in detail page. Click copy item ID. This is the only ID of item.
 2. Search item ID to find the corresponding items and you can share it to others.

#cfa7a0fOfficial guidelines of featured resources#n
1. Fineness: It is exquisitely made and can show the people, animals or items expressed reasonably and delicately, or it has a unique artistic style.The final work has a relatively excellent in-game performance.
2. Originality: It is an original work.
3. Simulation: If the model refers to real life items or other prototypical items.
4. Complete information: When uploading, please fill in the detailed and true title of the model items, not less than 16 letters of description, and choose 1-3 appropriate labels.

#cfa7a0fCriteria for Featured Resources#n
1) High quality production. The resource shall be exquisite and with particular art style. The design and production of the characters, animals or tools shall be able to show the idea of the creator. And the resource shall be able to perform smoothly in the game.
2) Must be Original Works. The resource must be original by the creator, which means they cannot be duplicated from other creators' resources.
3) Replica of realistic objects. If the resources in the item refer to objects from reality or other art works, they shall be highly similar to the original objects.
4) Integrity of information. The item must be uploaded with information including: ① a title which is true, detailed and can precisely describe the item; ② a description with more than 8 words for the item; ③ 1-3 suitable tags. An item with more than three tags will be selected preferentially.

孩子们在烈日下排起了整齐的长队。他们看起来很腼腆，眼睛里闪着喜悦的光。来自各地的爱心礼物纷纷被急切的孩子们打开，很快操场上便此起彼伏地响起了稚嫩的口琴声，空气中伴随着风声传来了欣喜的气息。
  以志愿者的身份来到这片土地之前，我一直想象不到自己与这里的孩子们生活环境如此截然不同。这里的人们凭借着自己的双手努力生活着，孩子们红扑扑的脸上也写满了坚定。
  在一片琴声笑声中，有个光着脑袋的小男孩跑过来对我轻声说了句“谢谢”。他咧着嘴告诉我，他想好好念书，长大后去更远的地方，看看外面的世界。我看着他的双眼，身体的疲惫也烟消云散。像他这样的小孩有很多，我可能无法帮助到他们中的大多数人，但只要能让一个孩子露出笑容，一切努力都值得了。

我是一个“魔法师”。我能用自己的身体，涂抹出世界上最鲜艳美丽的色彩。我的出生，伴随着许多人爱心的凝聚。这些互不相识的人们，送来了许许多多像我一样的小伙伴。我们来到这里的使命，就是奉献出他们的一片热忱。  有一天，我和我的小伙伴们都被放进了一个精致的“小房子”里，经历了万里旅途，来到了遥远陌生的山区。在这里，我们被陈列在一群衣着朴素，眼睛里却有着星光的孩子们面前。很快，我有了新朋友，一位扎着马尾辫的、脸上红扑扑的小女孩。她牵着我的手，在白纸上描绘出了我见过最好看的画作。小女孩看着我，再看看自己的作品，开心地笑了起来。  在这个瞬间，我才意识到，她的笑容才是世界上最美的色彩。

一年前，我家附近来了位陌生的朋友。它身材小小的，身体深深地扎进砂土里。我每天都会去原野里看他。它告诉我，它来自另一个世界，那里有很多跟它一样的兄弟姐妹们，与它一起旅行到了这里。
  很快，它的兄弟姐妹们也来了，小小的绿色脑袋站满了整片土地。我对它们的世界很好奇，每次过来都会问很多的问题。它们给我讲了好多奇妙生物的传说，我也跟它们讲了很多的故事，关于我、关于朋友、关于我生活的这片土地。它们会留在这里，一起让这里变得更加生机勃勃。
  看着它们一天天地长高，我心里特别高兴。它们说自己很快就能比我还高了。哼，我也在长高，才不会输给它们呢。

今天的梦，是一个开心的梦。在梦中，我跳起了最爱的舞，周围绽放了漫山遍野的粉红色樱花，散发着迷人的香味。我很喜欢这里，因为这儿有我的梦。  我喜欢跳舞，喜欢舞蹈时自由自在的感觉。可我却没有一双属于自己的舞鞋，直到我遇见了一群美丽的大哥哥大姐姐。  哥哥姐姐们来自很遥远的地方，他们给我们带来了希望。看着大家脸上洋溢的笑容，我仿佛也找寻到了希望。  “我想当舞蹈家！”，我坚定地看着哥哥姐姐们。  有一个大哥哥走过来摸了摸我的头。  “哥哥帮你实现这个愿望！”说完，他便递给了我一双红色的舞鞋。  我太开心了。双手捧过鞋子的时候，我感觉离梦境中的自己越来越近了。  我的希望，我的梦想，我的未来，我来了。

今天是一个美妙的夜晚，大山寂静地沉睡着，只有树林里传来轻轻的鸟叫声。我抬起头看着天空，看到了天上的点点繁星，它们仿佛在对着我微笑，这让我不禁想起来那群人。  听老师说，有一群从很遥远的地方来的大哥哥大姐姐，给我们带来我们需要的东西。我高兴极了。他们就像天上的星星一样，带着笑脸，给需要帮助的人们带来希望。  一颗星星的力量，是微不足道的，可是漫天的星星，却拥有巨大的能量。  我希望我长大了也能成为像他们一样的人，就像天上的星星一般，带着笑容的力量，一直闪耀下去。

迷梭梭与安吉洛斯 Ⅰ

清晰地记得她当时说“在来到阿拉善之前，我从未看过如此湛蓝的天空，也未看过晚上八九点还不下山的太阳，更从未见过一望无际的黄土与荒漠……”然后我好奇地问她外面的世界长什么样的？我听着她将外面世界的美好娓娓道来……
  后来我们一起在这片荒芜中挖坑，种上一株一株梭梭树，并在树林中立了一块标志牌。她一直非常担心，这些梭梭树苗在这么恶劣的环境中，它们能存活下来吗？荒漠能再现生机吗？哈哈哈，最后还是由我来安抚她焦灼不安的心情呢。在离开之前，她拿出相机，拍下这一片黄土和我们满带笑容充满希望的瞬间。
  哦对了，忘了告诉你，她是安吉洛斯，是一名爱心志愿者，嘻嘻。
迷梭梭与安吉洛斯 Ⅱ

前几天我翻看日记的时候，翻出那张与迷梭梭在阿拉善合影的照片，背景看上去满目荒凉，再次勾起了我对梭梭树苗的担心。我终于按捺不住内心的冲动，想亲眼去看一看那片土地上的梭梭树苗，它们还在吗？还是绿油油的样子吗？
  又是迷梭梭带我来到阿拉善。哇！眼前的一切我简直不敢相信，这一片曾经的荒漠，现在远远望去已经泛起了绿色，除了当时种下的梭梭树，竟然还有稀疏的野草。我直觉反应是来错了地方，直到看见不远处那块我们亲手安放的标志牌。算起来，距离我们上次来阿拉善才半年多而已，这里的主色调竟然从土黄变成了青黄相接。我无法形容内心的震撼，于是站在同样的位置，我们又拍了一张照片。
今天看到了一篇文章《多亏中印，地球比20年前更绿了》里面说“过去20年来地球新增绿化面积相当于整个亚马逊雨林覆盖的面积”，我又想起了我们在阿拉善种下的梭梭林，心中无比骄傲和自豪，阿拉善的梭梭树苗已经长高，它们改善了阿拉善的生态环境。  这一切都要感谢在迷你世界里参加公益的可爱孩子们，真心地祝愿你们永远健康、快乐成长！也感谢那些为了公益而贡献己力的人们，因为有了你们，这个世界才变得更加可爱、美好。

#cfa7a0f—What's the Creator Shop?#n
The Creator Shop is a platform for creators to sell map items within their own maps. It's one of the channels for creators to earn income from their maps.

#cfa7a0f—What are the tokens that can be used for sales?#n
1. Sales can be settled with Mini Coins, Mini Points, Mini Beans, and through ads.
 2. Mini Coins: Players can only acquire Mini Coins through top-up.
 3. Mini Points: Tokens obtained by players through watching ads.
 4. Mini Beans: Tokens obtained by players through home tasks or platform events.
 5. Ads: Income generated by players through the ads you've set up.
 6. Whenever a player spends the above tokens within your map, you can earn a certain percentage of the income. As for the specific income rules, you can visit the Creator Services platform.

#cfa7a0f—Token Types#n
1. Items will be sold with the token type you've configured. You will receive corresponding income after players make purchases. As for the specific income rules, you can visit the Creator Services platform.
 2. Mini Coins: Players can only acquire Mini Coins through top-up.
 3. Mini Points: Tokens obtained by players through watching ads.
 4. Mini Beans: Tokens obtained by players through home tasks or platform events.

#cfa7a0f—Item Categories#n
You can create custom item categories to allow players to find items based on categories.

#cfa7a0f—Item Events#n
1. During timed and discount events, item prices can be adjusted, while the other options are only recommended marks.
 2. Timed Event: Restricts the sale of the item for a certain number of days and quantity. Once the event ends, the item will be off the shelf. But it could be relisted.
 3. Ad Mode: After activating the ad mode, players can choose to either watch ads directly to obtain rewards or purchase them using the tokens you have set. Both modes can be activated at the same time. After players watch the ads, you can earn a share of the ad income.
 4. Hide Items: After hiding the item, players will not be able to see it in the Creator Shop, but you can still access it through triggers.
 5. List Item: When an item is off the shelf, players will be unable to purchase it.

Gameplay Introduction:
(1) You can embark on the magic forging journey after activating the chest and claim corresponding rewards according to the final star level of the chest.
(2) You can use Wish Code to activate or forge the chest. Wish Codes are priced at 10 Mini Coins each.
(3) In the initial stage, you can use 1 Wish Code to start forging and randomly obtain a chest with a star rating of 1 to 3. After activating the chest, you can choose to claim the rewards directly or continue to forge the chest.

[Tasks]
1. Tasks are divided into weekly tasks and seasonal challenge tasks. Complete tasks to get EXP, level up your Battle Pass, and receive corresponding item rewards.

 [Rewards]
1. At the end of the season, Season Pass levels and rewards will be reset. Please claim your rewards in time. Once expired, you will not be able to claim them.
2. Season Pass Points can be redeemed for items in the Redemption Shop. At the end of the season, Season Pass points will not be cleared, and they can be accumulated until the next season.

 [Purchase Season Pass & Levels]

 [Ranking List]

2. The Daily EXP Ranking List is based on the Season Pass EXP gained by all players in the server on the current day.
3. When there are too many players checking the Ranking List, there may be a slight delay in data refresh. You can check again later.

Once all players have joined the game, the countdown to the start of the game begins. When the timer runs out, the game officially commences and this event is triggered.
Detect if new players have entered the map; as soon as a new player arrives, this event gets triggered.

Whenever a player clicks on any block, this event is triggered, and it provides the coordinates of the clicked block. This can be used for features like golden touch, changing skins, or marking blocks.
When a character tosses a projectile, the event is triggered. Note that simply switching the held item to a projectile does not activate this event.
After a designated creature is spawned, this event is triggered. This can be used to create entrance effects. For instance, summoning an Ice Spirit Guard could trigger a snowy weather effect.

When a player enters a specified area, this event is triggered. This is often utilized for crafting horror or monster-infested maps, triggering creature spawn events. Entering and leaving area events cannot trigger developer-related actions, such as playing ads, displaying the item purchase window, or opening the Developer Shop.

When players exit the designated area, the event is triggered. Please note that entering and leaving area events cannot trigger developer-related actions, such as playing ads, displaying the item purchase window, or opening the Developer Shop.
The event is triggered after a specified amount of time has passed. This can be used to create time-related features, like horror games in Ring or hourly chimes.
Switching between different movement statuses triggers the event. For instance, transitioning from a static position to movement, or performing a jump while moving, will trigger the event.
Pressing the "W" key on the keyboard triggers the event. This event is only effective on PC since it detects only the 26 alphabetical keys, the space bar, and the Shift key.

Throwing projectiles, attacking creatures with weapons, or engaging in hand-to-hand combat with creatures triggers the event. Note that swinging or throwing objects into the air or hitting creatures with basketballs, soccer, or bombs will not trigger the event.

The event can be triggered by actions such as throwing projectiles (including bombs) to hit creatures or engaging in melee combat. Note: Using basketballs, soccer, or bombs to hit creatures won't trigger this event.
Player getting attacked by monsters, burning in lava, experiencing suffocation, or taking fall damage will trigger the event. This event can be utilized to create impact effects.
Regardless of the type of drops, adding it to the player's quick bar or backpack will trigger the event.
Players using projectiles, firearms, food, or books can trigger the event. Note: Using basketballs or soccer won't trigger the event.
Digging or using bombs to destroy blocks will trigger this event.

Used in the code for message delivery and coordinating the execution of different triggers. "Receive Broadcast" should be used in conjunction with "Send Broadcast" in the "Action - Game Logic" section. Once the "Send Broadcast" block is executed, the "Receive Broadcast" event will be triggered.
After the game starts, this event will be triggered every 2 seconds.
The event triggers 5 seconds after the start of the game.

When the weather changes from one status to another, this event will be triggered. Because there are various weather conditions, combining conditional statements allows different actions to be taken under different weather types.
The term "interface" refers to UI elements. When the specified UI interface is opened, this event is triggered.
Detect whether the specified button in the UI interface has been pressed and then released.
Detect whether the specified button in the UI interface has been pressed.
Triggered when a specified item is used. Can be used to give new combination abilities to items.
Triggered after sending specific texts in the chat box. Can be used to create in-game "cheat codes" like teleportation, healing, or weapon-related cheats.
This event is triggered whenever a creature is created. When combined with conditional statements, it can initialize the basic attributes of the creature.
When a creature collides with a player/creature, this event can be triggered. Combining it with special effect blocks can create collision effects.

When a player collides with another player or creature, this event can be triggered, returning the coordinates of the collided object. Combining it with special effect blocks can create collision effects.
When a player uses an emote, the event is triggered. By using conditional statements, different emotes can possess various fun abilities, such as summoning creatures or unleashing ULTs.
After a projectile hits a player, creature, or block, the event is triggered and returns the coordinates of the hit object. This can be used to create a "spear teleportation."

Used to set value attributes such as HP, stamina, speed, size, and ATK for specified players. This allows adjusting player attributes based on different play modes, such as increasing health or movement speed.
Can generate a specific number of creatures at a designated location, and their team color or lack thereof can be set.
Used to configure the weather conditions within the game world. While crafting your game, experiment with different weather combinations for surprising effects.
Controls the time within the game world, affecting lighting and sun position at different times.
Add a specified quantity of items to the player's quick bar or backpack, with priority given to the quick bar if there's an available slot.
Adjusts the gravity multiplier within the game world.
Assigns values to numerical variables, game attributes, player attributes, and creature attributes.
Sends text messages to specified players, displaying them in the form of floating windows.

Sends text messages to designated player groups, displaying them as floating windows. Player groups can consist of players within the same area, players on the same team, or even all players within the same map.
Enables the application of harmful, beneficial, neutral, or custom status to specific players. Examples include granting Lvl 5 Night Vision, inflicting Lvl 2 Freeze, or inducing Lvl 2 Polymorph.
Used to control the speed of time passage within the game world.
Used for sending messages in conjunction with the "Receive Broadcast" event. The "Receive Broadcast" event is triggered once the "Send Broadcast" block is executed.
Creates a specific projectile at location A and launches it toward location B.
Enables assigning values to "Player Variables," saving the player ID triggering an event or obtaining a player ID from the function library.
Enables distinct weather conditions in different terrains simultaneously. For example, causing a dust storm in the forest, sunny weather in the plains, and snowfall in the desert at the same time.
Controls permissions such as player mobility, attacking, and vulnerability to damage.
Plays special effects at specified positions or areas, often used to create attack effects or scene guidance.
Generates specific block types at designated positions or areas, with the option to specify their orientation. For instance, creating sulfur crystal sand at position A with its jet facing east.
Immediately defeats a specified creature. For instance, when a player's attack hits a creature, the targeted creature is defeated instantly.
Sets value attributes like HP, speed, size, and attack power for specific creatures.
Allows players to open the designated UI interface, typically used for starting UI interfaces or in scenarios with multiple interfaces.
Allows players to close the specified UI interface.
Sets the text content of "Text" and "Input Box" units in a UI interface. Needs to be used in conjunction with the "Open Interface" block. The text is displayed when the element's interface is open.
Sets the orientation of player objects.
Modifies the appearance of player objects.
Restores the appearance of player objects.
Clears all items from the player object’s quick bar, backpack, or equipment bar.

Set a destination point and make a creature object move there automatically, controlling the creature. This function has a distance limit; exceeding a certain range (about 32 blocks) will prevent it from triggering.
Replace all blocks within a specified area with a designated block, and the orientation of the blocks can be set.
Replace a specific type of block within a designated area with a specified block, and the orientation of the blocks can be set.
Clear all blocks within a specified area, without generating any drops.
Destroy all blocks within a specified area, generating drops.
Creates a blueprint building at a specified location, with the option to rotate the generated building.
Used to control the looping execution of triggers. By utilizing the "Repeat Execution" block, we can simplify the program and reuse code blocks, enhancing programming efficiency.

Decides whether to execute contained code blocks based on the truth or falsehood of a given condition. If the condition is true, the code blocks are executed; if false, the code blocks are skipped and execution continues downward.

Controls the runtime of triggers. Triggers generally follow a sequential structure, executing from top to bottom. When encountering a "Wait" block, the trigger pauses for a specified time before continuing execution.
Controls the specified number of iterations for trigger looping. If a loop contains an "Abort" block and the abort condition is met, the loop is prematurely terminated.

The block contains "If" and "Else" branches and executes the branch based on the provided condition. If the condition is true, the code blocks under "If" are executed; if false, the code blocks under "Else" are executed. You can add multiple condition branches by clicking the plus icon.

This block only takes effect for programs using "Trigger Events." It checks the truth or falsehood of the condition part within the trigger structure. If the condition aligns with the check, the program proceeds to execute the actions within the trigger.
Used to control the runtime of a program. When the program reaches this block, it waits for the conditions within the block to become true before continuing execution.
Used to terminate loop execution programs, usually used in conjunction with "If... Then..." blocks. In a loop, if the condition is met, the loop structure will "Exit Loop."

Controls whether the monitoring state of a trigger is enabled, as shown in the diagram below. If a trigger is still running while in the closed status, it won't immediately stop; it will wait until it finishes running before being closed.
Can halt the execution of a segment of a trigger.
Allows calling existing triggers based on event names and setting the number of times they're called.

Controls whether the monitoring status of all triggers within a trigger group is enabled. If a trigger is still running while in the closed status, it won't immediately stop; it will wait until it finishes running before being closed.

Used to determine if the current in-game world time falls within a certain range or is equal to a specific value. This can be used to create time-based mechanics like clocks or controlling monster spawns based on time.
Used to determine if the obtained item object belongs to a specific item type. This can be used to identify which weapon a player is using and design attack special effects accordingly.
Used for comparing values on both sides, checking if a value falls within a certain range or equals a specific value. This can be applied to numerical values, variables, and objects.
Used to determine if the current weather status within the game world matches a specific weather condition. This can be combined with different skyboxes to create different atmospheres.
Used to determine if the obtained block object belongs to a specific item type. Often used to create edible miniatures, vending machines, and more.
Used to determine if the current number of players in the game world falls within a certain range or equals a specific value.

Can obtain creature objects through various means and check if the obtained creature object belongs to a specific creature type. Different scores can be awarded for defeating different creatures, or distinct high attack power can be set for different creatures.
Used to determine if the current gravity multiplier within the game world falls within a certain range or equals a specific value.
Checks the item type the triggering player is holding when an event occurs. This can be used to create functionality where specific items need to be held to progress through designated areas.
Obtains the player from the event and determines if it's a specific player object. This can be used in scenarios with multiple players to designate a player to complete a task.
Checks if a player's attributes such as HP, stamina, level, speed, and attack power fall within a certain range or equal a specific value.
Determines whether the player's quick bar, backpack, or equipment bars contain a specified item. Used in treasure hunt games to check if players have completed tasks.
Checks if the emote in the event is a specific emote.
Evaluates the relationship between two boolean values.
Determines if a player object’s status effects are in a specific status.
Compares two strings for equality, used for creating decryption games within the game.
Checks if a creature's model size, jumping force, defense, attack power, and other attributes fall within a certain range.
Verifies if the quantity of a specific item in a player's quick bar or backpack falls within a certain range or equals a specific value. Used to enable the equipment crafting feature.
Obtains status effects from the event and determine if they belong to a specific state.
Compares the values of a specific coordinate's X, Y, or Z in a 3D space to check if they fall within a certain range or equal a specific value.
Determines whether a unit object in the event belongs to the interface's units.
Checks if the player's team belongs to a specific camp, used to create the feature that allows teammates to take zero damage.
Can access the appearance of players who are not in the current room.

We access your address book to help find your game friends on your phone.
We access your microphone for better voice chatting function.
We access your calendar to remind you to participate in events in time and claim rewards.

Hi everyone, this is Cherry! Holding these colorful blocks and carrying dreams that shine bright, we're here to work our magic together in the Mini World. Hey folks, I'm Xiaolongbao from Candy Studio. I hope all you Mini pals have a blast exploring my maps, just like you would savoring candy – sweet and heartwarming. Your joy powers my map-making spirit, and I wish you endless fun in the Mini World every day!

I'm Lovelock, the head honcho at Lovelock Studio, and it's a privilege to be part of the 2021 Mini World Creator Selection Event. Our maps may not be top-tier, but we put our hearts into every one of them. Moving forward, we'll double down on crafting more maps for your enjoyment. We also welcome your suggestions and feedback, as they help us understand your needs better and keep improving. Our motto is "Diverse tastes, all cherished!"

Thinking of planting peach trees? I'll hand you some soil blocks. Craving sugar cane? Here's a bunch of sand blocks. Feeling hungry? I'll whip up some tasty baguettes for you. Thirsty? I'll track down the purest springwater deep within the rainforest. Hey, what else do you fancy? Share it with Honey Pomelo! Let's use our blocks to craft vast star oceans and chase our dreams into the realms of poetry and beyond. Over in the distant, uncharted lands of Mira Star, there are stories waiting to unfold, and both you and I are part of them.

I'm Tear Nine, leading the Blissful Studio. Our studio may be small, with only seven members, just enough for games like Charades. However, it's an elite squad armed with the 2020 Creation Festival Gameplay Champion, the 2021 Creation Festival Building Champion, the 2021 Creation Festival Miniature Champion, an officially certified developer mentor, a popular Huya livestreamer, and a genius in ancient-style architecture! With this talented lineup, Blissful Studio can make anything happen!

As a veteran Mini player and map creator, I've been delivering endless joy to Mini players. I've seen the love between Mini players and creators grow over the years. Discovering the best game and encountering the most amazing players has been my driving force and ambition. Let's collaborate, and together, we'll witness a bright tomorrow. I believe you'll come to appreciate this creator more and more.

I've been a devoted Mini World player for a solid six years now! Fondly reminiscing about the times when my buddies and I crafted our own unique worlds in Mini World, those memories are pure childhood nostalgia! Over the years, my gaming crew has grown up, and finding pals to play with has become a bit of a rarity. But now, as developers, Mini World has brought us back together once again! We go by "The Alliance." And our passion for Mini World, constant innovation, and creating top-notch game maps that bring players joy is what fuels us!

Hey, folks! I go by NineBlocksTwo, and I've been exploring Mini World since 2016. I'm also a map creator with five years of experience under my belt. It's a real honor to be part of the 2021 Mini World Creator of the Year selection event. I'm committed to putting even more effort and heart into crafting top-quality works that players will truly enjoy. My hope is that my creations bring joy to the adventurers who explore them.

Greetings, everyone! I'm Li Yuki from Lemon Studio, and I'm thrilled to be part of the event. 2021 has flown by, and 2022 is right around the corner. Without realizing it, I'm entering my third year in Mini World. In the upcoming year, I'll continue creating maps that are fun and enjoyable for all of you. In the new year, I wish you all happiness, a fresh start in life, embarking on new journeys, embracing new hopes, carrying new dreams, and here's to Mini World becoming even better!

Greetings, gamers! I'm General, the brains behind General's Mansion Studio, now living the dream as a full-time developer. As a kid, I molded mud tanks and sketched arcade games on paper. Fast forward to today, and I can craft any gaming map I dream up in Mini World. It's not just a game — it's where dreams come to life. Thanks to this amazing platform, I hope to keep playing Mini World even when I'm rocking my golden years.

Back in 2015, a friend introduced me to Mini World, and I've been in and out of it for nearly six epic years. This game's been my loyal sidekick, and it's connected me with loads of like-minded pals. I thrive on creativity — building fantastical structures block by block, capturing screenshots to show off to my buddies. Even though I'm not a gaming whiz, I pour my heart into crafting unique gameplay maps. Every map is a fresh adventure and a whole new world.

Hello, hello! Can you hear me loud and clear? Hey there, gamers! It's ChillyWind￥, but you can just call me Windy! I'm all about role-playing and surviving in style. Hey, Mini World explorers! It's Pomelo Tea, your seasoned Mini World developer and top-tier critic, leading the charge at TeaTalk Studio. Brace yourselves for more epic maps coming your way soon!

Greetings, fellow adventurers! I'm Lone Whisper, a seasoned Mini World player turned developer and critic. My journey started as a gaming buddy for my little brother, just trying to be a good role model. But who knew, I'd fall head over heels for this sandbox gem? I'm here to inspire them to dive into map-making and hone those spatial skills!

Hello, Mini World enthusiasts! I'm Semi-Immortal, not just a Mini World video creator but also an ardent player and map maker. Hey there, I'm Tenten! I'm all about RPGs, and I've got a real soft spot for Mini World! I've been diving into Mini World for around 4 years now, and I know the game inside out. I've got my favorite game modes, and this one here is a real gem! If you're a fan, why not drop a vote my way?

Hello, hello, everyone! I'm Qiao Wan, your map maestro! I specialize in trigger-packed maps, and I've got a boatload of everyday-life-themed maps in the works. Ready to make my day? Give me your vote!

By day, I'm a tech whiz, but when the sun sets, I'm a gaming fiend! I dabble in all sorts of game genres during my spare time, and I'm a big fan of anime. Mini World has been my digital playground for a solid three years now. Crafting innovative maps is my jam, and I've covered the whole spectrum. From curated gems to earning the title of Critics in just a month, I've got over 20 handpicked maps in my portfolio. I'm a pro with all the developer tools, and I'm the go-to guy for tackling tech snags!

For nearly half a decade now, I've been knee-deep in Mini World adventures. Initially, a buddy lured me into Mini World's survival mode, but as the game evolved with updates, creation mode stole my heart. While I do enjoy diving into others' maps, there's nothing quite like the thrill of crafting my own. Building games is my passion, and it trumps playing any day. I've got a soft spot for vehicles, so you'll find most of my maps revolve around them. If you're feeling the vibe, how about a vote to rev up my engine?

I'm Chichi, your Mini World Architect Extraordinaire and sci-fi fanatic! I started as a total rookie but grew alongside Mini World, evolving into a versatile map creator specializing in chinoiserie, sci-fi, and cyberpunk genres. I'm a hardcore architect, never straying, all in pursuit of my dream to be a top-notch designer! I believe every player can shine in Mini World and put chinoiserie design on the global map!

I'm part of the FunBuzz Studio crew, and I've been immersed in the Mini World universe for over 2 years now. I thrive on diving into official events, clinching a few awards along the way. In my free time, I'm all about exploring creative gameplay. My Bear Baby map series has already seen two successful chapters, earning praise and love from fellow players. That's the rocket fuel for my creativity, and I've got more exciting maps lined up. I'm on a mission to turn Bear Baby into a real sensation!

Hey, gamers of the realm! Greetings, fellow gamers! I'm Yumo, a developer and a loyal Mini World enthusiast. I'm stoked to introduce myself through this platform. It's a true honor to be part of the 2021 Mini World Creator of the Year selection event, so don't forget to show your support! Every bit of encouragement fuels my passion for crafting top-notch content. I'm committed to delivering high-quality work and can't wait for a brighter future with Mini World. Stay tuned for more!

Greetings, folks! I'm Crow, the map magician from Horas Studio. We're on an endless quest to explore new horizons in the realm of gaming maps. Some of my standout creations include the classic Mini Special Ops, Blade of Swift Strikes, Douluo Continent, and our recent hit, Let's Cultivate Together. If you're loving our work, a little vote love from you would be epic! Thanks, fam!

Hey! I'm Demilow, a veteran player of 4 glorious years. I particularly enjoy crafting whimsical and fun gaming maps. So, lend a hand, or better yet, a vote, to keep the fun rolling. Thanks in advance!

I'm Jin World, a developer extraordinaire repping the General's Mansion Studio. I'm all about savoring life, with a motto that goes like this: "Crafting worlds like no other, living lives like no other!" Hope you dig my creations!

Hello, Mini World enthusiasts! I'm Semi-Immortal, not just a Mini World video creator but also an ardent player and map maker. My love for this game runs deep, and thanks to my amazing buddies' support, I'm proudly repping Mini World. I'm determined to give back to the Mini World community. So, if you're a fan of Semi-Immortal's vids and support my work, I'd be honored if you joined me on this journey. And I promise, there's a lot more exciting content in store!
Spinning Mini World tales with a dash of humor, spreading joy to viewers. Scored Top 10 spots in the Watermelon Play Finals for both 2020 and 2021!

A hilarious content creator who can't go a day without cracking jokes. Boasts a massive fanbase of over 9 million and loves to team up with fellow Mini World adventurers for some online multiplayer shenanigans.

A seasoned gaming commentator with over three years in the game and a follower following that's soared into the double digits. Crowned Mini World's Popularity Creator of 2020, and some videos have hit over 20 million views!

A life-loving, kid-friendly 'big kid' excelling at crafting funny, adorable, and storyline Mini World videos. He's the 2021 Mini World Ambassador, spreading positivity and promising even more entertaining content.

A video creator journeying through the galactic expanse of Mini World. Turning my passion into my profession is the happiest gig on Earth. My mission is to share this boundless joy with as many folks as possible!

No heartthrob looks here, but with a passion for creativity and a love for Mini World that's off the charts, I promise to keep that initial spark alive and deliver heaps of thrilling content daily. If you're a fan of my videos, join the cheer squad and fuel my fire!

I'm Memories, you might also know me as the No-Show King. I'm born as a wanderer, always itching for epic adventures. Yet, I stumbled upon Mini World and left my sword behind, becoming an adventurer within this pixelated realm. Here, I find solace, boundless freedom, and the quest for poetry and distant horizons.

I'm a cousin of Memories, you can call me Lil' Cousin. I'm into crafting all sorts of quirky survival maps and have a knack for playfulness. I enjoy creating stunning buildings and sometimes pulling pranks on my big cousin.

Introducing Para, the darling of Mini World's storytelling theater. As a member of the Watermelon Video Gaming Pros and a Mini World ambassador, she captures the whimsical tales, quirky voiceovers, and electrifying gaming moments that keep us all entertained.

Meet the Mini World maestro of original, uproarious videos. I've perfected the art of turning our wild gaming escapades into sidesplitting content. Join me in the gaming realm for endless laughter and adventure!

Greetings, folks! I go by SheepScroll, the mapper who takes on daily challenges from followers. With a comedic flair, you can catch my antics on Snack Video – just search for 'SheepScroll' for more laughs!

It's YinoSis in the house! My followers fondly call me the Survival Queen or the Survival Pixie. Brace yourselves for a wild ride through diverse survival streams that have everyone talking. Ready to join the party? Just look up Yino Mini World on Snack Video!
Meet Emperor! I'm Mini World's not-so-lucky Super Lucky Star. Why, you ask? Because I've got a knack for unearthing the unfindable in mines!

I'm your friendly gaming commentator, and I've been keeping the iQiyi platform buzzing for four awesome years. My specialty? Delving into thrilling storyline maps and immersive puzzle-solving adventures. If you're up for a wild ride, hit that follow button now!
Hey there, it's Sister Xiao Yu! I've got a knack for spinning intriguing tales within the colorful world of Mini World.
As a Mini storyline video creator, I whip up captivating stories that dive deep into the heart of the game. Join me in exploring fantastic gameplay and weaving them into unforgettable story videos.

I'm the Daredevil Wang, but most folks call me Old Wang! I'm the master of zany live commentary that's anything but ordinary. With over 3 million followers and a staggering 1 billion video views, I'm a real deal sensation. I even made it to the top influencers list in Q3 2021. Ready to laugh your heart out with me?

Hey there, it's SpicySnack, your friendly Mini World comedy creator! I've got a real Mini World passion, and I'm truly thankful for all your support and love. From zero to where I am now, it's been a rollercoaster journey filled with challenges and joys. It's all thanks to viewers like you. So, if you're a fan, don't forget to hit me with your vote — your support means the world!
Meet the talkative Pink Little Sheep, the entertainer who combines charm with mad gaming skills!
I'm the ultimate Mini World sensation, known for adding that extra flavor to the game. Crowned as the 2020 Mini World Creator of the Year,
I've got a whopping 2.29 million followers on TikTok who can't get enough of my hilarious videos and live streams.

Greetings, everyone! I'm Honey, a Mini World streamer, and I've come a long way from zero to a staggering 6 million followers. It's all thanks to your encouragement and support that I'm here today. Being nominated as a Mini World Creator of the Year is a dream come true, and I hope you'll keep cheering me on. I'll continue spreading boundless energy and joy!

It's the upbeat, fun-loving Honey Melody here! Hailing from Chongqing, she's your fiery game commentator with a knack for comedy and soothing vibes. You'll find her crafting fantastic house-building and survival videos. Feeling a bit down? She's here to brighten your gaming days!

Get ready to chuckle with ChickenJuiceBro, your game commentary pal in the Mini World! He's a Mini World game creator who's whipped up several animated Mini World adventures. ChickenJuiceBro's committed to bringing you even more valuable and heartwarming content in the future. Stay tuned for more exciting and heartwarming shows!

Greetings from Meow Planet! I'm Cat, your sweet and funny streamer. Thrilled to meet you in Mini World, where every vote you cast means a world of joy to me! My mission is to spread smiles everywhere! Catch me on Tiktok by searching for Cat Gaming. Thanks a million!

Greetings, fellow gamers! Anny here, your daily gaming companion. Gold-tier commentary is my jam, and Minis are my playground. Wanna join the fun? Hop over to Snack Video and search for Mini World Anny to catch me streaming!

The Mini World maestro of hardcore survival, known for boundless imagination. With reflexes as sharp as a razor, he's conquered all Mini World bosses in just 10 days. Ready to take on the ultimate survival challenge?

Hello, everyone! I'm your friendly neighborhood Geigei, a connoisseur of all kinds of follower-made maps that truly get my adrenaline pumping. And you know what? They've even dubbed me the Scream Streamer. My followers may always tease me, but I treat them like first loves. With hilarious voice-changing antics, I'll take you on a Mini adventure like no other!

Little Swallow's an original commentator and content creator with over 2.4 million followers across all platforms. He's your go-to source for top-notch gaming content that's fun, vibrant, and full of positivity.

Meet Bin, your friendly storyteller in the gaming universe. I turn thoughts into epic tales to share. We all have our inner sun, and mine is my personality, shining through with all its quirks. Perfection isn't real, but I'm on a journey to get as close as possible, filling those invisible gaps one step at a time. They say I'm the right choice. Join the fun now and you won't regret it!

Howdy, it's Brother Moon, your guide to gaming greatness in the community. While I might be a procrastinator (food is my top priority!), I'm dedicated to bringing you the best. Writing guides is my way of helping you out. I specialize in trigger tutorials and I'm your go-to when you need answers. When I discover something intriguing or unique in triggers, I'll write it up and share it with all of you. In the future, I'll continue delivering even better content to enhance our gaming community. If you're voting, remember to cast your vote for Brother Moon!

Hey there, folks! I'm Joyce, an avid adventurer in the Mini World. I set foot in this land back on May 28, 2016, and it's been a journey filled with laughter, tears, and countless discoveries. The original Mini World was like an endless, uncharted island, waiting for adventurers to explore. In 2020, thanks to the Developer Center, I stumbled upon the Mini World Box app, which opened up a whole new world of Mini knowledge for me. From fan art to master writer and brainstorming, I decided to put down roots and create my own corner here. Through continuous effort, I've achieved what I am today! Your vote means the world to me, and together, we can spread the joy to more players!

Hello there, everyone! I'm a content creator in the community, working on various aspects such as map reviews, game walkthroughes, Mini interviews, and answering questions as part of the Think Tank. I'm dedicated to excelling in all areas because I love the community. My map review skills stand out, and I hope to discover more shining maps through my words, contributing to the growth of the creative community. I might be relatively new to the community, and you might not know me well, but that's okay. Just explore my posts and drop a comment — I'll be sure to reply! Vote for me and make my day!

Hello everyone, I'm MuShi, a community organizer and a map storyteller. It's a pleasure to share my story with you all. I'm a map creator and a developer with a passion for music, building, and various modes. When I first delved into the world of story-based map creation, I was quite clueless. Thanks to the guidance of my dear friends, Candy and Joyce, I found my way into this realm of storytelling. As I immersed myself in the world of story restoration, I began to understand the challenges faced by Candy. And with her patient support, I gradually learned the ropes. I want to express my heartfelt thanks to Candy for her unwavering assistance. Together, we aim to reach new heights!

Hey there, I'm SouthTan, a walkthrough creator and contributor to the guidebook Creative World. I've also been nurturing talents within the community. If you've ever applied to become a verified content creator, chances are we've crossed paths! From April 2020 till now, it's been a wild ride of ups and downs, but we've also cultivated top-tier creators along the way. It's not just mentorship; it's a journey of mutual growth and discovery! Give me your vote, and thanks a million!
Your fan creator here! If my art floats your boat, give me a vote for the win!

Hello, everyone! I'm a content creator within the community, specializing in crafting captivating stories and providing walkthroughs. I love sharing knowledge and weaving intriguing narratives to enhance fellow players' gaming experience. You'll often find me in the comment section of those well-written stories and brilliant walkthroughs. In a gaming world filled with visually appealing avatars, I invite you to explore the captivating stories that lie beneath the surface!
I go by the name Artisan Fish, a dedicated verified content creator. My passion lies in crafting and drawing. Gimme your vote if you want to see more of my works!

My expertise lies in meticulously crafted maps. On February 28, 2020, I earned the title of a verified content creator. Since then, I've been consistently delivering top-notch map reviews and walkthroughs to players. I've also had the privilege of contributing to the development of official guidebook. Thank you for your support. I'll always remember why I began!

Without realizing it, I've been a part of this community for about three years now. I've come a long way to get where I am now, and I'm grateful for the support of all my fellow gamers. To all you art enthusiasts out there, keep up the good work! And I'm committed to crafting each piece with care, striving to bring you even better artwork!

Hey, I'm QiYuan, a verified artist. It was Mini World that sparked my interest in drawing. As long as I'm enjoying myself and have your support, that's all that matters. But your vote will still make my day!

You can call me Heart, a verified content creator in the fan art creation world. Over the past few years, I've churned out over two hundred pieces for Mini World. Among there works, many have clinched awards in various competitions, including excellence, creativity, third place, second place, and even first place. I've also been a part of the Creation Festival several times, achieving remarkable results. Moving forward, I'll continue to strive for even better results in the upcoming Creation Festival. Thanks to all of you for your support!

I once served as a disciplinary committee member in 2020, conducting inspections of Workshop maps to assist in addressing misconduct. As a verified content creator, I didn't hesitate to share my experience. While continually honing my skills, I also created several event pieces. I've also held the position of studio critics and contributed to the community as a senior inspector, actively countering fraud attempts. I was promoted to a Level Three Senior Inspector and received recognition for exceptional contributions. In 2021, I was invited to be part of the Shining Stars and participated in official online Mini World interviews. Currently, I serve as the discipline team leader, providing guidance to disciplinary team members and overseeing the inaugural galaxy inspection project, focused on enhancing the developer community.

Hey everyone, I'm Fishy, a spirited gal known as Lil' Fish among my friends. I came across Mini World back in 2019, and that first encounter left me brimming with curiosity. Fast forward to 2021, I stumbled upon the community and decided to become a content creator, focusing on miniatures and reviews. Crafting content often involves some serious brainstorming, but I'm committed to delivering top-notch stuff for all you players out there. I'll keep pushing myself to create the best content for the community! A big shoutout to everyone who's supported and encouraged me along the way. If you don't know me yet, just remember my ID Fishy!

Hey, gamers of the realm! Greetings, folks! I'm Sugar, and it's a real honor to be a nominee (first time and feeling quite flattered, to be honest). My passion lies in painting, and my dream is to become a full-fledged artist. I'll continue working diligently to create more fanart in the future and make Mini World a better place for everyone! It's a privilege if you enjoy what I do, so let's give it our all together!

I'm Yumi, a dedicated member of the community. I started my journey in Mini World back in 2017 and stumbled upon the Mini Community in 2019. It all began when I wanted to participate in the Stories with Prizes. Little did I know it would mark the start of my creative adventure. From May to December 2021, I penned nearly 170 posts, earning countless views, likes, and comments. I don't like to brag, but that's quite an achievement. I'll continue to put in the effort to give back to the community!

Hey, everyone! I'm Jelly, your average chatterbox who's also a bit obsessed with all things random. I'm a proud member of the Candy Crew. Yep, that's me! Give me your vote, and do it fast! Just vote for me! You won't regret it! Voting for me is the right choice, trust me!

Hello, folks! I'm Jinna, a quirky gal known as Pomelo among my buddies in the Sharing Community (the mystery of the nickname remains unsolved). I love reading, listening to music, and doing bullet journaling, just to name a few. When I first stumbled into this community, it was the mysterious roles and enticing rewards that hooked me. So, I rolled up my sleeves, worked tirelessly, and posted numerous map-sharing threads. Eventually, I earned the appreciation of Mecha Meow and became a manager in the community, guiding newcomers, maintaining harmony within the group, and consistently showcasing diverse map creations. My goal is to help the Mini World community thrive!

Hey, gamers of the realm! Hey there, everyone! I'm part of the management team in Sharing Community Group 1. I love to greet everyone with a smile and share my joy with the world. My interests are quite diverse, ranging from globetrotting to music, painting, and various sports. It's hard to believe that almost a year has passed since I joined the Sharing Community family. I started as a newbie, but I've grown into a team leader. I'm thrilled and honored that Sharing Community has provided me with this opportunity. In the days ahead, I'm committed to crafting top-notch maps, contributing my humble part to the community's prosperity!

Hello, everyone! I'm the dashing and charming HunterFox. I'm a devoted gamer, specializing in sandbox and action titles. With four years of Mini World under my belt, I excel in organizational leadership, taking responsibility and getting things done. I've served in multiple official Mini World organizations, spearheading various events. I value player feedback and strive to maintain a positive image in every gamer's heart. Wherever there's action, wherever there's Mini World chatter, you'll find me. Join me on this adventure, spread your wings of dreams, and let's explore Mini World together!

Hi, I'm Milk, and I have a confession to make: I'm a chronic procrastinator when it comes to posting my artwork ( ????`). It's quite surprising, even to me, that I made it here. I love to mess up with my cat (even though I often end up getting scratched), beat rhythm games, and create art. I can be a bit shy, usually opening up only to those I'm familiar with. But I'm determined to become more sociable and outgoing!

I'd like to express my sincere gratitude for being invited as a Star of Community candidate. I joined the Mini World Sharing Community as a content creator right from its inception. Eventually, I was appointed as a leader, and together with the official team, we crafted systems and tutorials to make it easier for newcomers. The community has blossomed with diverse cultures and rich content. I'm captivated by Mini World's limitless creativity. And my aim is to do my part and make our community shine even brighter.

Hey, fellow gamers! I go by the name Pomelo , and I'm your walkthrough guru within the Mini World community. But deep down, I'm just a player like you. In my spare time, I'm all about art and drawing. It's truly an honor to be nominated as the Community Star of the Year. Let me share my journey, from a total novice to a verified content creator I am today! It all began on June 5, 2020, when I first dipped my toes into the Mini World, thanks to a friend's recommendation. At first, I was clueless, but then I stumbled upon Mini Box, and that's when I discovered the coveted V badge. Guided by a friend, I embarked on the path to become a verified content creator. Through continuous experimentation and learning how to craft articles, I finally became an intern by the end of 2020. And after putting in dedicated effort, on March 1, 2021 , I officially became a verified content creator. This is the story of my journey to becoming who I am today. Fellow gamers, don't hesitate to reach out and join the fun! To all the interns on the path to the V badge, may you get there soon! And for those aspiring to become a creator, keep up the great work! You've got this!

Hello, everyone! I'm Nono, a senior inspector within the Mini World community. I also wear hats as a journalist, a walkthrough creator, and even lead a team in the developer community's think tank! I've always wanted to contribute my bit to the community. I'm a responsible and slightly goofy gamer, and folks have given me various nicknames like NonoPig and Chubby Nono. My passion lies in drawing, and I've never given up on it. I entered the Mini World in January 2018, and by June of the same year, I discovered Mini Box. From being a complete novice to where I stand now, there's a tapestry of stories to share. But first and foremost, I want to express my gratitude to Mini World and all the friends who've supported me throughout. Special thanks to Candy, for her care and guidance!

I'm a verified writer in the community, also doubling as a journalist. I have a deep passion for writing, and being part of this community has not only introduced me to many friends but also honed my writing skills. I've even got the chance to unearth numerous stories behind the scene. Most importantly, I get firsthand information about Mini World. I love the feeling of sharing happiness, and I'll keep giving it my all!

I'm a verified clay modeling enthusiast, specializing in crafting Mini World characters. If you ask me which creation is my favorite, the answer is simple: I love each and every one of them! Looking forward to creating more high-quality works for the community in 2021!

Hey there, folks! I go by the name Rainbloom, and it's a pleasant surprise to find myself among the candidates! This year, I got lucky enough to join the ranks of the community's artistry team as a verified content creator. Art is an ever-evolving journey, and during this past year, I've had the privilege of crossing paths with many verified skilled artists. I look forward to progressing together with all of you and contributing my bit to the community. And as for my hobby... Guess what it is?

Greetings, everyone! I'm YunChen, a verified content creator for a year and a half now. Time really flies, and I've gained so much within this community. I love to discuss about writing and share the joys of life with all of you. This is an organization filled with love. This is a community filled with passion. While my work may have its flaws, I hope those who enjoy it will continue to do so! I'll keep pushing forward to bring you even better pieces!

I'm a fresh face here, and I won't bore you with the challenges of my journey. My favorite pastime is crafting guides for various miniature scenes. I get a real kick out of bringing real-world items into the Mini World. I hope you all enjoy my works, and I'll keep exploring new avenues of creativity in the future!

Q: What's the Creator Level?
 A: Think of Creator Levels as the showcase of a creator's talents in Mini World. The higher your level, the more impressive your creative skills. Plus, we'll even throw in some sweet benefits based on your Creator Level, like extra save slots and access to higher-level tools.

Q: What's Creative Point? How to boost Creative Point and Creator Level?
 A: Creative Points measure your creative prowess from every angle.
 To boost your Creative Points, focus on crafting high-quality maps, and keep an eye on key data, like how well your maps perform and how much they're loved by the Mini World community. We evaluate your recent creative endeavors and data on a weekly basis. If your work shines, you'll be racking up those Creative Points in no time!

Q: What are Creator Tasks?
 A: By completing Creator Tasks, your in-game actions have a chance to generate Creative Points. Additionally, some Creator Tasks offer up Creative Points and Activity Points right on the spot. Likes: The total number of likes your map has received from players.
Total Ad Revenue: The earnings generated from players watching ads within your map.
